title: Simply supported beam reactions
match: point load of 12 kn at 2 m from a
statement: A simply supported beam AB of length 6 m (pin at A, roller at B) carries a point load of 12 kN at 2 m from A and a uniformly distributed load of 3 kN/m over its full length. Determine the vertical reactions at A and B.

given: Uniform load $w = 3\ \text{kN/m}$ over the full span

referencePlan.method: Moments about A for R_B, then vertical equilibrium for R_A.

steps.title: Sum moments about A
steps.rationale: Taking moments about A removes R_A from the equation, leaving R_B as the only unknown.
steps.hint1: Which point can you take moments about so that one reaction disappears?
steps.hint2: Sum moments about A. Treat the distributed load as its resultant acting at midspan.
steps.checkQuestion: Why does R_A drop out of this equation?

steps.title: Solve for R_B
steps.rationale: The moment equation has one unknown; solve it.
steps.hint1: Collect the load moments on one side.
steps.hint2: Divide the total load moment about A by the span.

steps.title: Vertical equilibrium
steps.rationale: With R_B known, the vertical force balance gives R_A.
steps.hint1: What else must balance besides moments?
steps.hint2: Sum vertical forces: both reactions against the point load and the total distributed load.

steps.title: Reactions
steps.rationale: Both reactions found; they add up to the total load of 30 kN.
steps.hint1: You have both equations; finish the arithmetic.
steps.hint2: Subtract R_B from the total vertical load.
